items.title: #7 chunking, hashing and block store
items.detail: Round-3 findings F1-F8 fixed with regression tests (builder, head c9e418d; main merged; scope clean; BlockId/ChunkRef untouched; I re-ran locally: 109 crate tests pass, fmt/clippy clean). Fixes: durable pack-id high-water so ids are never reused, checkpoint bound to a pack creation nonce, acknowledgements bound to pack nonce + block id + state, zero-filled header salvaged, recovery copies into a new pack instead of rewriting in place (crash-atomic, tested at every write), a pending-loss marker so loss stays reported until acknowledged, bounded fsynced torn-tail sidecars that fail closed (Error::Quarantine), salvage() that trusts no headers, one allocator for GC. Measured: 4000-case crash-reopen model 0 acked lost / 0 wrong bytes / 0 false corruption; 1800-case power-loss 0/0/0; 180 s 8-thread stress 0 errors; 9 of 14 mutants killed, 3 survivors judged equivalent. Format changes are additive or ignored-and-rebuilt (index.cix magic bump, ACKED entries 68 bytes). BLOCKED: macOS CI FAILS on the exact head: `f4_bit_flip_in_a_synced_record_never_deletes_bytes` got Err(Locked) on reopen right after the first Store was dropped. Passes locally 5 of 5, so intermittent, but it means the directory LOCK is not released synchronously on drop: a real bug that affects every reopen (core, GC, daemon restart). Builder reproducing it in a 20,000-iteration loop on Mac and VM and fixing, with Store::close(). Also: builder's own caveats: throughput A/B not repeated (one loaded run: ingest 191 MiB/s, read 547; no no-regression claim), F7's probe passed on the old code so that fix stands on the code path only, cargo test grew to 467 s. Third round in a row found data-loss bugs in new recovery code, so after this fix a round-4 critic runs BEFORE merge.

items.title: #10 garbage collection
items.detail: Builder reports done (head bbb2679): mark with subtree skipping, hole refs skipped, ExtraRoots for core's pinned blocks, access-time hints (hint only), crash-safe compaction on the store's allocator, dry run, cancellation. Builder's numbers: 681 tests pass workspace-wide, cowfs-gc 47 tests, kill -9 x120 (370 live block reads verified), 4-ordering crash matrix with a negative control; mark of 33,516 live blocks 0.017 s, compaction 2.1 MiB/s (slow; sweep is quadratic in pack count via per-pack checkpoint, named as the first thing to fix). Builder found and fixed 2 of its own bugs (hints header written on every flush; bench corpus collided past 1000 files). NOT YET MERGEABLE: (1) ubuntu CI is red on the head, macOS passes; (2) SAFETY: ExtraRoots is infallible, so a pinned-blocks answer cannot be marked incomplete; core's pinned_blocks currently returns empty under write contention (core critic: 38.4M of 38.4M polls), which would let GC free live data: builder making the trait fallible with abort-the-sweep on any error and a re-poll after mark; (3) it carries 33 store files: waits on #24 (store, also fixing a Locked-after-drop race that hit GC's m09 test once); (4) no critic has reviewed it yet and it is the component that deletes data: a critic runs after these fixes. Design decisions in docs/v1-gc.md: the reference barrier is required for any free (without one GC only reports); cross-cycle incrementality is root-granular, node-level skipping needs a meta change. Gaps: 1M-block mark not run, two Gc handles over one store unsupported.

items.title: #11 Linux FUSE mount
items.detail: Round-2 blockers fixed (builder, head 02a1cf1) and I re-ran the Linux VM mount suite myself: 48 unit + 40 mount + 11 regress pass, no mounts left; Mac fmt/clippy/45 tests pass. F3 create + failed open no longer leaks the file; F4 an empty non-eof readdir page is retried then fails loudly (it used to list nothing with no error), zero-based cookies accepted; F1 a held descriptor now sees a rewrite behind the mount (revalidator drops pages of open descriptors every attr_ttl, default on; the invalidation must be (off=0,len=-1)); F2 the ordering claim is corrected: kernel-ordered dependent requests stay ordered, independent requests may overlap, the Vfs must be linearizable (now in the trait docs, #41); the builder measured that the kernel already serialises renames per superblock (max concurrent rename seen by the Vfs = 1) so one lane is enough, provable by test; F5 a wedged lane is reported by health()/wedged_lanes() without killing the mount. Adopted the frozen trait (unknown kind = EIO + log, Retry = EAGAIN, readdir_attrs, fsync(ROOT_INO,false) barrier). fsx 1e5 x 2 seeds 0 mismatches. 16 critic + 6 new mutants: all die except one equivalent and one the builder explains. BLOCKED: the branch never merged main: GitHub mergeable_state is dirty (conflicts) and no CI has run on the head. Builder merging main, re-verifying in the VM 10x and waiting for both CI jobs. Decisions still open for you: cross-adapter permission policy (FUSE follows POSIX, NFS lets the owner write), SoleWriter wiring (the control plane must call the Invalidator outside any Vfs call), and a Linux mount job in CI (`cargo test -p cowfs-fuse -j4 -- --include-ignored --test-threads=1`).

items.title: #26 cowfs-core: Vfs over store and meta
items.detail: ROUND-2 VERDICT: NOT mergeable. Held up: conformance 132 + 2 heavy pass, crash 3 seeds x 120 ops incl. a negative control (barrier ordering holds), fsync(file) durable, directory-rename renumbering, released alias is Stale not another file, snapshot names match the CLI table. BLOCKERS: B1 fsync(ROOT_INO,false) is a no-op (the trait's whole-mount barrier; after kill the fsynced file is gone); B2 pinned_blocks() returns empty while any writer holds a node lock (38,372,183 of 38,374,217 polls returned 0 of 3 chunks), so GC could free live data; B3/B4 a failed rename_snapshot completes at the next open and leaves a visible staging snapshot, a failed promote_base leaves `base` gone from the live mount, promote_base with replace skips the name-collision check. HIGH: virt.ino missing file reads as 0 so a restore reuses inode numbers and a 0-byte marker refuses the whole mount; re-entrant aliases read lock in load_node missing from the lock audit; ns/flush locks held across fsync-bound meta commits (14-thread hammer: more than 90 s of zero progress, liveness not a cycle). MEDIUM: zero-id chunk ref reads as zeros, any flush error poisons forever, read of u32::MAX on 1 TiB sparse allocates 4 GiB, torn intent ignored. 4 mutants survive. Not run by the critic: Linux VM, fsx 1e5, 180 s hammer, 500k RSS, bench, crash during a flush. Builder fixing B1-B12 and re-merging main (metadata, trait, suite, NFS, vfs-path now on main). STILL cannot merge until #24 (store) lands. NOTE for #39: pinned_blocks must return Err(Busy) rather than a partial answer; GC must treat that as 'abort the sweep'.
